722	/-! ## O1 `derive` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
723	
724	/-- Effect of `derive(source, place, mode)` (MM-03.3 §3, O1): a new active authority with
725	origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
726	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
727	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩
728	
729	/-- O1.4 (MM-03.3 §3): every existing authority stays compatible with the derived one in the
730	resulting state. Not a precondition of `derive`: it follows from O1.1–O1.3 under I1
731	(`derive_compat_redundant`, A11). -/
732	def DeriveCompat (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
733	  ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q,
734	    OptP (effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p) (fun e => Compat e m) True
735	
736	/-- Preconditions of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1), in order: 1 active origin, exercisable (A2);
737	place still usable (MM-03.3.1); 2 requested footprint within the origin's; 3 mode permitted by
738	the effective authority of the origin on each leaf. O1.4 is removed (A11): it follows from the
739	others under I1 (`derive_compat_redundant`). O1.5 is not restated: `derive` deactivates
740	nothing. -/
741	def DerivePre (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
742	  s.Active src ∧ s.Exercisable src ∧ s.Usable q ∧
743	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, p ∈ s.afp src) ∧
744	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m)
745	
746	instance (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (DerivePre s src q m) := by
747	  unfold DerivePre; infer_instance
748	
749	/-- `derive` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
750	def DeriveStep (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
751	  Guarded (DerivePre s src q m) (deriveEff s src q m)
752	
753	/-! ## O2 `split` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
754	
755	/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (MM-03.3 §3, O2): one derived `Modify` authority per
756	region, held by the current frame; the origin remains a logical authority. -/
757	def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
758	  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }
759	
760	/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p`: an active descendant of `src` in
761	mode `Modify` covering `p` (MM-03.3 §3, O2.4). -/
762	def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
763	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
764	    False
765	
766	instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
767	  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance
768	
769	/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active, exercisable
770	(A2) authority with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
771	(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
772	structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
773	exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
774	activity. -/
775	def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
776	  s.Active src ∧ s.Exercisable src ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
777	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
778	  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
779	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)
780	
781	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
782	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
783	  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance
784	
785	/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
786	def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
787	  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)
788	
789	/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/
790	
791	/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
792	authority becomes inactive. -/
793	def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
794	  | some x => { s with A := s.A.set a { x with active := false } }
795	  | none => s
796	
797	/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
798	descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor. O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions)
799	is not represented in the kernel. -/
800	def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
801	  s.Active a ∧
802	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
803	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∉ s.D q)
804	
805	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance
806	
807	/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
808	def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
809	  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)
810	
811	/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/
812	
813	/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
814	def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
815	  | .place r => partOf P r q
816	  | .frame _ => False
817	
818	instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
819	  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance
820	
821	/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5): the destination becomes
822	`Init`, the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited ones included, join those of
823	the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority held by the source or one
824	of its parts is now held by the destination (A4); every place owned by the source or one of its
825	parts is now owned by the destination, without moving (A5). -/
826	def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
827	  { s with
828	    P := s.P.map fun pl => if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := .place dst } else pl
829	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
830	      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
831	    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
832	      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
833	    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := .place dst } else y }
834	
835	/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
836	(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
837	def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
838	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
839	    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False
840	
841	instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
842	  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance
843	
844	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
845	1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source,
846	and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
847	on the source and on the destination (A2); 4 no active derived
848	access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
849	(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame; 7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
850	(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8). O4.3 holds by construction. -/
851	def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
852	  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
853	  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
854	  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
855	  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
856	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
857	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
858	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, NoEscape s x (s.pframe dst)) ∧
859	  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false)
860	
861	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
862	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
863	  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance
864	
865	/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
866	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
867	  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)
868	
869	/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
870	
871	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
872	the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
873	by `depsOf`. -/
874	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
875	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
876	
877	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
878	1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6). O5.2 (real origin of the rights or storage) is not
879	representable: the state does not relate a value to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4
880	hold by construction. -/
881	def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
882	  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q)
883	
884	instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
885	  unfold DependPre; infer_instance
886	
887	/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
888	def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
889	  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)
890	
891	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/
892	
893	/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
894	the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
895	def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
896	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
897	  | some o => .place o
898	  | none => .frame f
899	
900	/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
901	earlier local (A5). -/
902	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
903	  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
904	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
905	
906	/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
907	def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
908	  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone
909	
910	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
911	`nF` pushed; the parameters, derived by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
912	appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
913	authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
914	arbitrage 2; A4). -/
915	def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
916	  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
917	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
918	    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
919	      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
920	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
921	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
922	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
923	    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
924	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }
925	
926	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active (non-empty
927	stack); each parameter is an active authority derived by the caller and held by it (A3); the
928	parent and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its
929	parent. -/
930	def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
931	  s.F ≠ [] ∧
932	  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
933	    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
934	  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
935	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
936	      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
937	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True
938	
939	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
940	    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
941	  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance
942	
943	/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
944	def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
945	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
946	  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)
947	
948	/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/
949	
950	/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
951	the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). -/
952	def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
953	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False
954	
955	instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
956	  unfold Survives; infer_instance
957	
958	/-- First surviving authority of a list (A7). -/
959	def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
960	  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)
961	
962	/-- Authority `a` after the exit (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): released unless it survives; a surviving
963	authority is re-attached to its first surviving strict ancestor along `origin`, which is its
964	origin when that origin survives. -/
965	def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
966	  if Survives s F₀ a then
967	    match y.origin with
968	    | none => y
969	    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
970	  else { y with active := false }
971	
972	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): the exiting frame has a caller; every
973	anchor of a place still usable after the exit has a surviving authority among itself and its
974	ancestors along `origin`; every surviving derived authority has a surviving strict ancestor.
975	Otherwise the chain reaches a root that does not survive, and the exit is rejected. -/
976	def ExitPre (s : S3) : Prop :=
977	  match s.F with
978	  | _ :: F₀ => F₀ ≠ [] ∧
979	      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
980	        ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
981	      (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s F₀ a → s.org a ≠ none →
982	        firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) ≠ none)
983	  | [] => False
984	
985	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre s) := by
986	  unfold ExitPre; split <;> infer_instance
987	
988	/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4; A5; A7): return to the caller; each anchor
989	replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its ancestors; authorities that do
990	not survive released; surviving derived authorities re-attached. -/
991	def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
992	  match s.F with
993	  | _ :: F₀ =>
994	    { s with
995	      F := F₀
996	      D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
997	      A := mapI (exitG s F₀) 0 s.A }
998	  | [] => s
999	
1000	/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
1001	def ExitStep (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre s) (exitEff s)
1002	
1003	/-! ## Abstract reads and writes (MM-03.3 §5) -/
1004	
1005	/-- Ordinary read condition of a leaf by authority `a` (MM-03.3 §5, `canRead3`): an effective
1006	authority permits observation, the leaf is initialised, the needed dependencies are valid. The
1007	type and storage contract is not represented. -/
1008	def CanReadLeaf (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
1009	  effective s a p ≠ none ∧ s.I p = .init ∧ DepsValid s p
1010	
1011	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (CanReadLeaf s a p) :=
1012	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
1013	
1014	/-- `canRead3` (MM-03.3 §5): ordinary read of leaves `ls` by authority `a`, exercisable by the
1015	current frame (A2). -/
1016	def canRead3 (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop :=
1017	  s.Exercisable a ∧ ∀ p ∈ ls, CanReadLeaf s a p
1018	
1019	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (canRead3 s a ls) := by
1020	  unfold canRead3; infer_instance
1021	
1022	/-- `read3` as a relation (MM-03.3 §5): a read does not change the state. -/
1023	def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1024	  Guarded (canRead3 s a ls) s
1025	
1026	/-- `canWrite3` (MM-03.3 §5): `a` exercisable by the current frame (A2); on each leaf, effective
1027	`Modify` of `a` and needed dependencies valid. The clause "no other ordinary authority with an
1028	incompatible effective right" is removed (A11): it follows from the first under I1
1029	(`canWrite3_excl_redundant`). The type and storage condition is not represented. -/
1030	def canWrite3 (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop :=
1031	  s.Exercisable a ∧ ∀ p ∈ ls, effective s a p = some .modify ∧ DepsValid s p
1032	
1033	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (canWrite3 s a ls) := by
1034	  unfold canWrite3; infer_instance
1035	
1036	/-- Effect of a write (MM-03.3 §5): written leaves become `Init`. -/
1037	def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 := { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }
1038	
1039	/-- `write3` as a relation (MM-03.3 §5). -/
1040	def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1041	  Guarded (canWrite3 s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
1042	
1043	/-! ## Lemmas on the effective authority (MM-03.3.5) -/
1044	
1045	theorem effOf_cases {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : effOf m ds = some m') :
1046	    (ds = [] ∧ m' = m) ∨ (ds ≠ [] ∧ Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
1047	  unfold effOf at h
1048	  by_cases h0 : ds = []
1049	  · simp [h0] at h; exact .inl ⟨h0, h.symm⟩
1050	  · by_cases h1 : Mode.modify ∈ ds
1051	    · simp [h0, h1] at h
1052	    · simp [h0, h1] at h; exact .inr ⟨h0, h1, h.symm⟩
1053	
1054	theorem mode_eq_observe {m : Mode} (h : m ≠ .modify) : m = .observe := by cases m <;> simp_all
1055	
1056	theorem mem_descModes {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} :
1057	    m ∈ descModes s a p ↔ ∃ j y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧
1058	      a ∈ s.ancs j ∧ y.mode = m := by
1059	  simp only [descModes, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
1060	  constructor
1061	  · rintro ⟨j, -, h⟩
1062	    split at h
1063	    · rename_i y hy
1064	      split at h
1065	      · rename_i hc; cases h; exact ⟨j, y, hy, hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2, rfl⟩
1066	      · cases h
1067	    · cases h
1068	  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
1069	    refine ⟨j, (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hy).1, ?_⟩
1070	    simp [hy, h1, h2, h3]
1071	
1072	theorem effective_some {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : effective s a p = some m) :
1073	    ∃ x, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint ∧
1074	      effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) = some m := by
1075	  unfold effective at h
1076	  split at h
1077	  · rename_i x hx; split at h
1078	    · rename_i hc; exact ⟨x, hx, hc.1, hc.2, h⟩
1079	    · cases h
1080	  · cases h
1081	
1082	theorem effective_eq {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
1083	    (ha : x.active = true) (hp : p ∈ x.footprint) :
1084	    effective s a p = effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) := by
1085	  simp [effective, hx, ha, hp]
1086	
1087	theorem Mode.le_refl (m : Mode) : m.le m := by cases m <;> simp [Mode.le]
1088	
1089	/-- The effective mode does not exceed the mode of the authority (MM-03.3.5). -/
1090	theorem effective_le {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)

1118	/-- I1, effective exclusivity strengthened structurally (MM-03.3 §2, A1): two distinct active
1119	authorities, unrelated by `origin`, covering the same leaf, `SharedMutable` leaves included,
1120	both have the proper mode `Observe`. The pass-1 statement on effective modes is the theorem
1121	`effective_compat`. -/

1124	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →

1128	on each leaf of the derived footprint, the leaf is in the footprint of the origin and the
1129	derived mode does not exceed the origin's. -/

1131	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →

1149	invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing places;

1161	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧

/-! F1: `free p` leaves an active, exercisable access on storage owned by `p`.
Frame 1: 0 value v (frame-owned), 1 owned storage p (owner place 0), 2 nested owned storage

def f1c : S3 := deriveEff f1b 2 2 .observe      -- authority 3, held by frame 1
def f1d : S3 := freeEff f1c 1                   -- free p

example : Reachable KF f1d :=
  .free (.derive (.write (.enter .init (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide)))

example : DeriveStep 2 2 .observe f1b (.ok f1c) := .ok (by decide)

findings.cause: Missing coverage, possibly a spec defect. FreeAccessOK, FreeAnchorOK and the pin clause of FreePre only look at `footprint s.P p`. But `free p` also makes every place owned by p unusable, because the owner chain now runs into a dead place (A5 Usable). freeS also releases the roots of those places, since they are held within p. A frame-held access derived from such a root therefore survives with an inactive origin, and read3/write3 still accept it on a place that is no longer Usable. endUse handles exactly this case through EndingLeaf, which covers places that stop being usable; free does not. A5 says 'Un emplacement possédé n'est pas nécessairement une allocation distincte de MM-02', so milestone 1 does not settle whether the nested storage survives the free physically. free_no_dangling holds only because it is limited to the leaves of p.

findings.title: free p leaves an active, exercisable access on storage owned by p, which is no longer usable; endUse rejects the same state
findings.location: formal/Ern/MM03.lean:2804-2831 (FreeAccessOK, FreeAnchorOK, FreePre pin clause); compare EndingLeaf/EndUseAccessOK at 2666-2685
findings.cause: Missing coverage, possibly a spec defect. FreeAccessOK, FreeAnchorOK and the pin clause of FreePre only look at `footprint s.P p`. But `free p` also makes every place owned by p unusable, because the owner chain now runs into a dead place (A5 Usable). freeS also releases the roots of those places, since they are held within p. A frame-held access derived from such a root therefore survives with an inactive origin, and read3/write3 still accept it on a place that is no longer Usable. endUse handles exactly this case through EndingLeaf, which covers places that stop being usable; free does not. A6 words both preconditions the same way ('aucune autorité active dérivée sur son empreinte détenue ailleurs'), yet the module applies them differently. A5 says 'Un emplacement possédé n'est pas nécessairement une allocation distincte de MM-02', so milestone 1 does not settle whether the nested storage survives the free physically. free_no_dangling holds only because it is limited to the leaves of p.
